vocabulary.meaning_en: the things you usually do every morning
vocabulary.example: My morning routine starts with a glass of water.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to stop sleeping
vocabulary.example: I wake up at six on weekdays.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to clean your teeth with a toothbrush
vocabulary.example: Brush your teeth before you go to bed.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to clean your face with water
vocabulary.example: Cold water helps me wake up when I wash my face.

vocabulary.example: He takes a quick shower after the gym.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to put clothes on your body

vocabulary.meaning_en: to have the first meal of the day

vocabulary.meaning_en: the things you usually do in the afternoon

vocabulary.meaning_en: to travel to school to study

vocabulary.meaning_en: to go to the place where you do your job
vocabulary.example: I go to work at eight o'clock.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the meal you eat in the middle of the day
vocabulary.example: Let's have lunch at one.

vocabulary.meaning_en: school work that students do at home
vocabulary.note_ar: اسم غير معدود: لا نقول homeworks
vocabulary.example: I finished my homework before dinner.

vocabulary.meaning_en: short trips to do tasks outside the home
vocabulary.example: I need to run some errands this afternoon.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the things you usually do in the evening
vocabulary.example: Reading is part of my evening routine.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the main meal of the evening
vocabulary.example: Dinner is ready!

vocabulary.meaning_en: to rest and become calm
vocabulary.example: After a long day, I like to relax on the sofa.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to look at programmes on television
vocabulary.example: The kids watch TV for an hour after dinner.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the things you do before going to sleep
vocabulary.example: A good night routine helps you sleep better.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to clean plates, cups and pans
vocabulary.note_ar: أمريكي: wash / do the dishes، بريطاني: do the washing-up
vocabulary.example: I'll wash the dishes if you cook.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make your clothes ready for the next day
vocabulary.example: I prepare my clothes the night before to save time.

vocabulary.meaning_en: things a family does together
vocabulary.example: Board games are our favourite family activities.

vocabulary.meaning_en: making food with other people
vocabulary.example: Cooking together is fun on weekends.

vocabulary.meaning_en: making a place clean with other people
vocabulary.example: Cleaning together makes the job faster.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a time when family members gather and talk
vocabulary.example: We had a family meeting about the summer holiday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an evening when people watch a film together
vocabulary.example: Friday is movie night in our house.

vocabulary.meaning_en: going to see family members
vocabulary.example: We spend Eid visiting relatives.

vocabulary.meaning_en: covered with dust
vocabulary.example: The old books were dusty.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a book where you write about your days
vocabulary.example: She writes in her diary every night.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to read so that others can hear
vocabulary.example: The teacher read the story aloud.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make an unhappy or worried face
vocabulary.example: He frowned when he saw the bill.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to speak very quietly
vocabulary.example: She whispered the answer to her friend.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to act as if something is true when it is not
vocabulary.example: He pretended to be asleep.

vocabulary.meaning_en: one of the soft light parts that cover a bird
vocabulary.example: A feather fell from the bird.

vocabulary.meaning_en: at some time in the past
vocabulary.example: A famous writer once lived in this house.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the sound of someone walking
vocabulary.example: I heard footsteps in the hallway.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to become wider
vocabulary.example: Her eyes widened in surprise.

vocabulary.meaning_en: being used or lived in by someone
vocabulary.example: Sorry, this seat is occupied.

vocabulary.meaning_en: normal, used or happening every day
vocabulary.example: These are my everyday shoes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a short planned sleep during the day
vocabulary.example: Grandpa takes a nap after lunch.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to fall asleep without planning to
vocabulary.example: I dozed off on the train.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a very short extra sleep, often after an alarm
vocabulary.note_ar: snooze button = زر الغفوة في المنبّه
vocabulary.example: I pressed snooze twice this morning.

vocabulary.meaning_en: delaying things you should do
vocabulary.example: Procrastination is a student's biggest enemy.

fine_lines.title: every day vs everyday
fine_lines.explanation_ar: تُنطقان بنفس الطريقة لكن تختلفان في الكتابة والوظيفة. every day (كلمتان) عبارة ظرفية معناها «كل يوم» وتجيب عن سؤال how often؟ أما everyday (كلمة واحدة) فهي صفة معناها «يومي / عادي / روتيني» ويجب أن يأتي بعدها اسم تصفه.

examples.sentence: I wash my face every day.
She goes to work every day.
Cleaning together is an everyday activity for us.

fine_lines.title: nap vs doze off vs snooze
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الثلاثة لها علاقة بالنوم الخفيف أو القصير. nap قيلولة مقصودة ومخطط لها غالباً في النهار. doze off أن يغلبك النوم رغماً عنك دون تخطيط، مثلاً أمام التلفاز أو في المواصلات. snooze غفوة قصيرة جداً، وأشهر استخدام لها زر snooze في المنبّه لتسرق دقائق إضافية من النوم.

examples.sentence: I usually take a short nap after lunch.
Omar dozed off during the movie.
I hit the snooze button three times this morning.

fine_lines.title: take a shower vs have a shower
fine_lines.explanation_ar: المعنى واحد: يستحم. take a shower هي الأشيع في الإنجليزية الأمريكية، و have a shower أشيع في الإنجليزية البريطانية. ونادراً ما يقول الأمريكي shower وحدها كفعل في الكلام اليومي.

examples.sentence: I take a shower every morning.
He's having a shower right now.

fine_lines.title: do the dishes vs do the washing-up
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلاهما بمعنى غسل الأطباق. wash the dishes أو do the dishes أمريكية وهي الأشهر عالمياً، و do the washing-up تعبير بريطاني شائع.

examples.sentence: It's your turn to do the dishes.
I'll do the washing-up after dinner.

expressions.meaning_ar: يسهر حتى وقت متأخر ليعمل أو يذاكر
expressions.example: She burned the midnight oil to finish her report.

expressions.meaning_ar: إذا تأخرت أو تكاسلت فستخسر الفرصة
expressions.example: The tickets sold out in an hour. You snooze, you lose!
I spent the morning running errands.
You look tired. Why don't you take a nap?
Can you read the instructions aloud?
I never miss my morning walk.

grammar.title: Future continuous: an action in progress at a future time
grammar.explanation_ar: التركيب: will be + الفعل مع ing. نستخدمه لحدث سيكون جارياً ومستمراً في لحظة محددة في المستقبل. إذا ذكرنا وقتاً دقيقاً وسنكون في منتصف الحدث وقتها، نستخدم will be doing وليس will do.
examples: At 8 p.m. tomorrow, I'll be watching the match.
I can't meet you tomorrow morning. I'll be sitting in a lecture.
At 9 p.m. tonight, I will be doing my homework.

grammar.title: Future continuous for polite questions about plans
grammar.explanation_ar: سؤال Will you wash the dishes? بالمستقبل البسيط قد يبدو طلباً مباشراً أو أمراً. أما Will you be washing the dishes later? فهو سؤال لطيف عن خطط الشخص ونيّته دون ضغط عليه، لذلك يُعدّ أكثر تهذيباً.
examples: Will you be washing the dishes later?
Will you be using the car tonight?
Will you be going to the shop this afternoon?

questions.question: "These are my ___ shoes." (normal shoes I wear daily)
questions.explanation_ar: everyday كلمة واحدة صفة تصف الاسم shoes.

questions.question: "I go to the gym ___."
questions.explanation_ar: every day كلمتان بمعنى كل يوم وتدل على التكرار.

questions.question: At 9 p.m. tonight, I ___ my homework.
questions.explanation_ar: وقت محدد في المستقبل والحدث مستمر فيه، إذن المستقبل المستمر will be doing.

questions.question: Which question is the most polite way to ask about someone's plans?
choices: Will you be washing the dishes later?
questions.explanation_ar: المستقبل المستمر يسأل عن الخطة بلطف دون طلب مباشر.

questions.question: He fell asleep in front of the TV without planning to. He ___.
questions.explanation_ar: doze off = يغفو رغماً عنه دون تخطيط.

questions.question: A short planned sleep during the day is a:
"To burn the midnight oil" means to:
choices: work or study late into the night
questions.explanation_ar: التعبير يعني السهر لوقت متأخر للعمل أو المذاكرة.

questions.question: In British English, people usually say "___ a shower".
questions.explanation_ar: البريطانيون يقولون have a shower والأمريكيون take a shower.

questions.question: "Errands" are:
choices: short trips to do tasks outside

questions.question: The opposite of "occupied" (a room, a seat) is:
questions.explanation_ar: occupied = مشغول أو مأهول، وعكسها vacant = فارغ.
